status: frozen before downloads and model fitting
cleaning: exclude all feature-identical conflicting-label groups then keep first identical feature row; record removed counts and original row indices
preprocessing: train-only median numeric imputation; train-only most-frequent categorical imputation and one-hot unknown-ignore; LR numerical standardization; no resampling/weighting
test_policy: reserved, no predictions or outcomes evaluated; labels used for stratification
selection: all five source-selected datasets; no exclusions based on solver outcomes
limitations: random splits are computational score generation, not future-shift/subject/temporal validation; no extreme imbalance or clinical generalization claim
